title: The Mask Seller
text: A stall in the Faceless City holds masks row on row, each a face from your own past: a sister, a first love, a dead friend, yourselves as children. The seller behind the stall has no face. It would like one, it says, very much.

options.label: Buy back a face you lost, and remember who you used to be.

outcomes.text: It fits perfectly. They had forgotten what it was like to be that person.

options.label: The Leader trades their own face for the finest mask, tempted by its splendour.

outcomes.text: The mask is magnificent. In the mirror, the Leader is no longer sure who looks back.

options.label: Burn the stall and every face on it so no one else is tempted.

outcomes.text: Every face screams as it burns. Some of the voices you know.
